note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Write a digest of each project's recent history
purpose: Arcadia writes a readable summary of recent activity for itself and each project it manages, on a schedule and without being asked. Each summary is built from the project's own records and must not invent outcomes.
serves: The Project outcome of the operator following progress without reading every record.
done_when: Each active project and the portfolio get daily, weekly and monthly digests in the vault, and an unchanged digest is not rewritten.

actions.title: Compose a project's digest for a time window
actions.why: Turns a project's logs, dispatch events and decisions into a readable summary for a day, week or month.
actions.done_when: A digest covers only its window, every claim traces to a recorded fact, and no outcome is stated that the records do not support.

actions.title: Save each digest to the Obsidian vault
actions.why: Puts the summary where the operator reads project notes, labelled as AI-written.
actions.done_when: A digest is saved to the vault labelled as AI-narrated, and saving an unchanged digest writes nothing.

actions.title: Send digests on daily, weekly and monthly schedules
actions.why: Makes the summaries arrive on time, and a failure for one project does not block the others.
actions.done_when: Each project and the portfolio roll-up get one digest per due period, and a failure for one project is logged without stopping the rest.
